name: credit-referral
title: A weak credit band is referred to the credit officer, who approves with a deposit
summary: Priya Raman's credit band is D with no energy debt: the eligibility table refers the application to a person. Marco, in customer care, may not decide it (no rule lets him); Olivia, the credit officer, approves with a deposit of 200 EUR, which is collected by direct debit before the switch.

output.reasons: Priya asked for a fixed price for a year; with a deposit held, the 12-month fixed plan keeps her bills predictable while she builds a payment history.

output.message: Welcome, Priya! Your supply at 5 Station Road starts on {{supply_start_date}} on our 12-month fixed plan, with our standard mix. Your deposit of 200 EUR is held on your account and returned after twelve months of payments on time. Your first bill follows a month later, paid by direct debit.

steps.say: Marco, customer care, tries to decide the referral, and is refused: only credit officers decide
Olivia, credit officer, approves with a deposit of 200 EUR

output.reason: A thin credit file, not a bad one: no debt and a stable income. A deposit covers the risk.

steps.say: Priya confirms the 12-month fixed plan in the portal
The e-signature service reports the signed contract
The registry confirms the switch: the supply starts today
